title: Carbon filters
description: Activated carbon filters for gaseous pollutants, odours and harmful gases — metal and plastic cylinders, plus cassette-type solutions.
paragraphs: Activated carbon filters are used to separate gaseous air pollutants, eliminate odours and adsorb harmful gases. Metal cylinders are made with a durable construction so they can be refilled with activated carbon.

Plastic cylinders for single use are also available; this design has a minimal pressure drop (lower than metal cylinders), a large adsorption surface and low weight. Both cylinder types share the same mounting method.
Carbon can also be filled into flat cassette-type filters depending on customer needs and equipment.
